_title: Psychiatric Diagnostic Evaluation and Psychotherapy Services

criteria.text: Patient has a psychiatric illness and/or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior patterns or maladaptive functioning in personal or social settings, suggestive of a psychiatric illness
criteria.source_span: the patient has a psychiatric illness and /or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior patterns or maladaptive functioning in personal or social settings, which may be suggestive of a psychiatric illness

criteria.text: Not medically necessary when rendered to a patient with a medical/neurological condition (e.g. dementia, delirium) that has produced a cognitive defect severe enough to prevent effective communication and assessment
criteria.source_span: when it is rendered to a patient who has a medical/neurological condition such as dementia, delirium, or other psychiatric conditions, which have produced a severe enough cognitive defect to prevent effective communication and the ability to assess the patient

criteria.text: Not necessary when the patient has a previously established neurological/dementia diagnosis and is not amenable to evaluation and therapy, unless one of the listed exceptions applies
sub_conditions: an acute and/or marked mental status change
a request for second opinion
diagnostic clarification is necessary to rule out additional psychiatric or neurological processes, which may be treatable
criteria.source_span: when the patient has a previously established diagnosis of a neurological condition or dementia and is not amenable to the evaluation and therapy, unless there has been an acute and/or marked mental status change, a request for second opinion, or diagnostic clarification is necessary to rule out additional psychiatric or neurological processes, which may be treatable

criteria.text: A psychiatric diagnostic evaluation can be conducted once, at the onset of an illness or suspected illness; repeatable by the same provider only if one of the listed conditions holds
sub_conditions: an extended hiatus in treatment occurs
the patient requires admission to an inpatient status for a psychiatric illness
a significant change in mental status requiring further assessment
criteria.temporal: An extended hiatus is generally defined as approximately 6 months from the last time the patient was seen or treated for their psychiatric condition.
criteria.source_span: A psychiatric diagnostic evaluation can be conducted once, at the onset of an illness or suspected illness. The same provider may repeat it for the same patient if an extended hiatus in treatment occurs, if the patient requires admission to an inpatient status for a psychiatric illness, or for a significant change in mental status requiring further assessment

criteria.text: The medical record for the diagnostic evaluation must document all of the listed elements
sub_conditions: The reason for the evaluation/patient’s chief complaint
A referral source (if applicable)
History of present illness, including length of existence of problems/symptoms/conditions
Past history (psychiatric)
Significant medical history and current medications
Social history
Family history
Mental status exam
Strengths/liabilities
Multi-axis diagnosis or diagnostic impression list-including problem list

Treatment plan (including methods of therapy, anticipated length of treatment to the extent possible, and a description of the planned measurable and objective goals related to expected changes in behavior or thought processes)
criteria.source_span: The diagnostic evaluation should include:

criteria.text: Psychotherapy is medically necessary when patient has a psychiatric illness and/or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior or maladaptive functioning
criteria.source_span: Psychotherapy will be considered medically necessary when the patient has a psychiatric illness and/or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior or maladaptive functioning

criteria.text: Psychotherapy services must be performed by a person licensed by the state where practicing, whose training and scope of practice allow performing such services
criteria.source_span: Psychotherapy services must be performed by a person licensed by the state where practicing, and whose training and scope of practice allow that person to perform such services

criteria.text: Psychotherapy must be provided as an integral part of an active treatment plan directly related to the patient’s identified condition/diagnoses
criteria.source_span: Psychotherapy must be provided as an integral part of an active treatment plan for which it is directly related to the patient’s identified condition/diagnoses

criteria.text: Patient should be amenable to allowing insight-oriented therapy techniques to be effective
criteria.source_span: The patient should be amenable to allowing insight-oriented therapy such as behavioral modification techniques, interpersonal psychotherapy techniques, supportive therapy, and cognitive/behavioral techniques to be effective

criteria.text: When a medical evaluation and management service is provided the same day as psychotherapy by the same provider, the two services must be significantly different and separately identifiable
criteria.source_span: Some psychiatric patients receive a medical evaluation and management service on the same day as a psychotherapy service by the same physician or other qualified health care professional. These services to be medically necessary should be significantly different and separately identifiable

criteria.text: Psychotherapy/psychoanalysis services are not medically reasonable and necessary when rendered to a patient with a medical/neurological condition producing a cognitive deficit severe enough to prevent effective communication for insight-oriented therapy
criteria.source_span: Psychotherapy/psychoanalysis services are not considered to be medically reasonable and necessary when they are rendered to a patient who has a medical/neurological condition such as dementia, delirium or other psychiatric conditions, which have produced a severe enough cognitive deficit to prevent effective communication with interaction of sufficient quality to allow insight oriented therapy

criteria.text: Psychotherapy services are not medically necessary when primarily teaching grooming skills, monitoring ADLs, recreational therapy, or social interaction
criteria.source_span: Psychotherapy services are not considered to be medically reasonable and necessary when they primarily include the teaching of grooming skills, monitoring activities of daily living, recreational therapy (dance, art play), or social interaction

criteria.text: Treatment plan for outpatient psychotherapy/psychoanalysis must be updated periodically
criteria.temporal: generally at least every three months
criteria.source_span: the treatment plan for a patient receiving outpatient psychotherapy or psychoanalysis services, (i.e., measurable and objective treatment goals, descriptive documentation of therapeutic intervention, frequency of sessions, and estimated duration of treatment) will be updated on a periodic basis, generally at least every three months

criteria.text: If psychotherapy services are performed incident-to, all incident-to rules must be met and the person providing the service must be licensed
criteria.source_span: If psychotherapy services are performed incident-to, all incident-to rules must be met, and the person providing the psychotherapy service must be licensed in the state to perform psychotherapy

criteria.text: Medical record must indicate the medical necessity of each psychotherapy/psychoanalysis session
sub_conditions: The presence of a psychiatric illness and/or the demonstration of emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to alter baseline functioning

A detailed summary of the session, including descriptive documentation of therapeutic interventions such as examples of attempted behavior modification, supportive interaction, and discussion of reality

The degree of patient participation and interaction with the therapist, the reaction of the patient to the therapy session, documentation toward goal-oriented outcomes and the changes or lack of changes in patient symptoms and/or behavior as a result of the therapy session
criteria.source_span: For psychotherapy and psychoanalysis services, the medical record documentation maintained by the provider must indicate the medical necessity of each psychotherapy/psychoanalysis session and include the following:

criteria.text: Group psychotherapy must be led by a person authorized by state statute to perform this service
criteria.source_span: it must be led by a person, authorized by state statute to perform this service

criteria.text: Group size should be a size considered therapeutically successful (maximum 12 people)
criteria.source_span: The group size should be of a size that can be considered therapeutically successful (i.e., maximum 12 people)

criteria.text: Patient has a psychiatric illness and/or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior patterns or maladaptive functioning in personal or social settings (group therapy)
criteria.source_span: Group therapy will be considered medically necessary when the patient has a psychiatric illness and /or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior patterns or maladaptive functioning in personal or social settings

criteria.text: Group psychotherapy must be ordered by a provider as part of an active treatment plan directly related to the patient’s diagnosis, adhered to and endorsed/monitored by the treating physician
criteria.source_span: Group psychotherapy must be ordered by a provider as an integral part of an active treatment plan for which it is directly related to the patient’s identified condition/diagnosis. This treatment plan must be adhered to and should be endorsed and monitored by the treating physician or physician of record

criteria.text: The specialized skills of a mental health care professional must be required
criteria.source_span: The specialized skills of a mental health care professional must be required

criteria.text: Group psychotherapy not medically necessary when cognitive deficit prevents effective communication with therapist/group members
criteria.source_span: Group psychotherapy services are not considered to be medically reasonable and necessary when they are rendered to a patient who has a medical/neurological condition such as dementia, delirium, or other psychiatric conditions, which have produced a severe enough cognitive deficit to prevent effective communication including interaction of sufficient quality with the therapist and members of the group

criteria.text: Music therapy, socialization, recreational activities, art therapy, excursions, sensory stimulation, eating together, cognitive stimulation, or motion therapy are not medically necessary
criteria.source_span: Other services such as music therapy, socialization, recreational activities/recreational therapy, art classes/art therapy, excursions, sensory stimulation, eating together, cognitive stimulation, or motion therapy are not considered to be medically reasonable and necessary

criteria.text: Family psychotherapy medically necessary only in clinically appropriate circumstances when primary purpose is treatment/management of the patient’s condition
sub_conditions: when there is a need to observe and correct, through psychotherapeutic techniques, the patient’s interaction with family members
where there is a need to assess the conflicts or impediments within the family, and assist, through psychotherapeutic techniques, the family members in the management of the patient
criteria.source_span: Family psychotherapy will be considered medically reasonable and necessary only in clinically appropriate circumstances and when the primary purpose of such psychotherapy is the treatment/management of the patient’s condition

criteria.text: Patient has a psychiatric illness and/or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior or maladaptive functioning (family therapy)
criteria.source_span: Family psychotherapy is considered to be medically reasonable and necessary when the patient has a psychiatric illness and/or is demonstrating emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to cause inappropriate behavior or maladaptive functioning

criteria.text: Family psychotherapy not reasonable/necessary for unconscious or comatose patients
criteria.source_span: In certain types of medical conditions, such as the unconscious or comatose patient, family psychotherapy would not be medically reasonable or necessary

criteria.text: Medical record must indicate the medical necessity of each family psychotherapy session
sub_conditions: The presence of a psychiatric illness and/or the demonstration of emotional or behavioral symptoms sufficient to alter baseline functioning

The summary of themes addressed in the family psychotherapy session, including descriptive documentation of therapeutic interventions such as examples of attempted behavior modification, supportive interaction, and discussion of reality

The degree of patient participation and interaction with the family members and leader, the reaction of the patient to the group, the group's reaction to the patient and the changes or lack of changes in patient symptoms and/or behavior as a result of the family psychotherapy session
criteria.source_span: For family psychotherapy services (with or without the patient present), the medical record documentation maintained by the provider must indicate the medical necessity of each family psychotherapy session and include the following:

criteria.text: Family psychotherapy must be conducted face to face by physicians, psychologists, or other licensed mental health professionals
criteria.source_span: Family psychotherapy must be conducted face to face by physicians (MD/DO), psychologists, or other mental health professionals licensed or authorized by state statutes and considered eligible for reimbursement

criteria.text: Psychoanalysis uses psychoanalytic theory and transference to gain insight into unconscious motivations and conflicts
criteria.source_span: Psychoanalysis uses a special technique to gain insight into a patient's unconscious motivations and conflicts using the development and resolution of a therapeutic transference to achieve therapeutic effect

criteria.text: Psychoanalysis is generally considered unsuitable for psychoses
criteria.source_span: Psychoanalysis is generally considered unsuitable for psychoses

criteria.text: For psychoanalysis, medical record must document indications, description of transference, and use of psychoanalytic techniques; physician must be trained/credentialed; CNS/NP not eligible for payment
sub_conditions: the medical record must document the indications for psychoanalysis, description of the transference, and that psychoanalytic techniques were used
The physician using this technique must be trained and credentialed in its use
CNS’s and NP’s are not eligible for payment for psychoanalysis
criteria.source_span: Additionally, for psychoanalysis, the medical record must document the indications for psychoanalysis, description of the transference, and that psychoanalytic techniques were used

criteria.text: Medical record must indicate presence of one of the listed communication factors for interactive complexity services
sub_conditions: The need to manage maladaptive communication among participants (related to, e.g., high anxiety, high reactivity, repeated questions, or disagreement) that complicates delivery of care
Caregiver emotions or behaviors that interfere with implementation of the treatment plan

Evidence or disclosure of a sentinel event and mandated report to a third party (e.g., abuse or neglect with report to state agency) with initiation of discussion of the sentinel event and/or report with patient and other visit participants

Use of play equipment, physical devices, interpreter, or translator to overcome barriers to diagnostic or therapeutic interaction with a patient who is not fluent in the same language or who has not developed or has lost expressive or receptive language skills to use or understand typical language
criteria.source_span: The medical record must indicate that the person being evaluated has one of the following communication factors present during the visit:

criteria.text: Medical record must include adaptations used to overcome communication difficulty, the rationale, and treatment recommendations
sub_conditions: the medical record must include adaptations utilized in the session to overcome the difficulty in communication and the rationale for employing these techniques justifying the interactive complexity of the service
The medical record must include treatment recommendations
criteria.source_span: Additionally, the medical record must include adaptations utilized in the session to overcome the difficulty in communication and the rationale for employing these techniques justifying the interactive complexity of the service

criteria.text: Psychotherapy for crisis is an urgent assessment/history, mental status exam, and disposition for a life-threatening or complex presenting problem requiring immediate attention
criteria.source_span: Psychotherapy for crisis is an urgent assessment and history of a crisis state, a mental status exam, and a disposition

criteria.text: Periodic documentation of patient's capacity to participate/benefit, estimated treatment duration, and measurable goals is required for psychoanalysis/psychotherapy including group and family
sub_conditions: the estimated duration of treatment in terms of number of sessions required and the target symptoms, measurable and objective goals of therapy related to changes in behavior, thought processes and/or medications, methods of monitoring outcome, and why the chosen therapy is an appropriate modality either in lieu of or in addition to another form of psychiatric treatment
criteria.source_span: The documentation for psychoanalysis or psychotherapy services including group and family psychotherapy should include on a periodic basis the patient’s capacity to participate and benefit from psychotherapy/psychoanalysis

criteria.text: There must be a reasonable expectation of improvement in the patient's disorder or maintenance of function where decline would otherwise be expected
criteria.source_span: There must be a reasonable expectation of improvement in the patient’s disorder or condition, demonstrated by an improved level of functioning or maintenance of level of functioning where decline would otherwise be expected in the case of a disabling mental illness or condition or chronic mental disorder

criteria.text: Once no further improvement is expected and there is no reasonable expectation of improvement, psychological services are no longer reasonable or medically necessary
criteria.source_span: When a patient reaches a point in his/her treatment where further improvement does not appear to be indicated and there is no reasonable expectation of improvement, the psychological services are no longer considered reasonable or medically necessary

criteria.text: Routine psychiatric/psychological services to evaluate or treat a nursing-home-placement adjustment disorder do not constitute medical necessity
criteria.source_span: Psychiatric and/or psychological services routinely performed to evaluate and/or treat an adjustment disorder associated with placement in a nursing home do not constitute medical necessity

criteria.text: Patient must have the capacity to actively participate in all prescribed therapies, except family therapy without the patient present
criteria.source_span: The patient must have the capacity to actively participate in all therapies prescribed, except for family therapy without the patient present

notes:
Covers all 7 service sections and all 20 numbered limitations. g3 is an exclusion-with-exceptions modeled as logic=one_of on the escape clauses -- a genuine ambiguity in how the schema represents "exclusion voided by any one of several conditions". Limitations #15 (HIPAA/privileged-info filing) and #20 (utilization-review risk flag) were left out -- record-keeping/audit notes, not testable coverage conditions.

Scored on atomic facts (extract.py::_atoms), not top-level criteria -- see that module for why. Under atom scoring, recall on this policy is 0.71, lower than the 0.92 seen on an earlier extraction run of the same text: the later run captured the parent documentation requirements (e.g. "medical record must indicate medical necessity") but did not itemize the detailed sub-bullet list (chief complaint, referral source, etc.) the way the earlier run did. Confirmed by inspecting the cached payload directly -- this is real run-to-run sampling variance in extraction detail/itemization depth, not a scoring bug. Worth flagging in the eventual writeup as a concrete limitation: itemized documentation lists are where extraction depth is least consistent across runs.
